breaking_news.headline: 4 things investigators learned about the dysfunction at Trump's Labor Department
breaking_news.summary: A report from Labor Department investigators found former Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer violated her own department's policy prohibiting harassment. She resigned in April.

breaking_news.headline: Former State Department energy envoy on how the war in Iran is impacting gas prices
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to former State Department energy envoy David Goldwyn about how the war in Iran continues to affect gas and diesel prices.

breaking_news.headline: Trump issues new executive orders on beef sales to pacify American cattle ranchers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump's latest executive orders allows ranchers to sell meat directly to consumers. Ranchers have been upset over Trump's plan to boost beef imports in a bid to lower prices.

breaking_news.headline: Union electricians welcome data center boom
breaking_news.summary: The boom in data centers has brought plenty of work and lots of overtime to union electricians, putting them at odds with many communities trying to block new data center construction.

breaking_news.headline: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
breaking_news.summary: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

breaking_news.headline: Has the economy gone C-shaped?
breaking_news.summary: A K means the rich and poor are pulling apart. A C supposedly means they're coming back together. We hear the case for both. Which letter you see may depend on what you choose to pay attention to.

breaking_news.headline: Chrystia Freeland negotiated with Trump. Now she's watching a trade war unfold
breaking_news.summary: Chrystia Freeland understands the U.S.-Canada relationship from her time at the negotiating table. Here's what she sees now.

breaking_news.headline: Fourteen go on trial over deadliest Channel small boats disaster
breaking_news.summary: At least 30 men, women and children drowned when their dinghy capsized on 24 November 2021.

breaking_news.headline: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
breaking_news.summary: The Iran-backed Yemeni group's attacks have injured 73 people and caused fires at oil facilities, Saudi authorities say.

breaking_news.headline: British widow faces deportation from Sweden after 22 years
breaking_news.summary: A 78-year-old British woman is facing deportation for failing to fill out a Brexit residence application on time.

breaking_news.headline: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
breaking_news.summary: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"

breaking_news.headline: Renoir paintings worth millions stolen in French museum heist
breaking_news.summary: It is the latest in a string of high-profile art thefts in Europe that has again put the security of museums and galleries in the spotlight.

breaking_news.headline: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
breaking_news.summary: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

breaking_news.headline: Carney says US trade war 'will come at a cost' as Canada strikes back on tariffs
breaking_news.summary: Canada's levies - as high as 50% - will apply to nearly $20bn of US products, from steel to T-shirts.

breaking_news.headline: Argentina to file criminal case against oil company operating in Falklands
breaking_news.summary: The move comes days after President Javier Milei stepped up Argentina's claims of sovereignty over the Falklands.

breaking_news.headline: UK's third-biggest taxpayer to leave for Greece
breaking_news.summary: Chris Rokos plans to open an office in Athens, reports say, and was ranked third in the Sunday Times's list of the UK's top taxpayers.

breaking_news.headline: 'Tirana teeth': Albania hopes to be the new Turkey for dental work
breaking_news.summary: The Balkan nation is aiming to become a new centre for medical tourism.

breaking_news.headline: AI will cure cancer in our lifetime, claims boss of UK chip giant
breaking_news.summary: Arm Holding's chief executive Rene Haas says artificial intelligence will find a solution to the disease.

breaking_news.headline: Heathrow and Gatwick among airports hit by air traffic control problems
breaking_news.summary: Departures from a number of airports have been affected by a technical problem affecting air traffic control provider Nats.
